title: oldenlandia graminifolia
intro: Oldenlandia graminifolia, commonly known as Chinese gentian or Yin-chai-huo, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a medicinal herb traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Oldenlandia graminifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, relieving pain, and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Oldenlandia graminifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
